title: CarbTune Pro redesign shell and workflow foundation
scope: Build the first reviewable implementation milestone of the approved CarbTune Pro redesign on the design/knowledge-graph-v1 branch. Do not merge redesign application code to main. Preserve CT-0059/CT-0060 infrastructure while replacing the visible Build 51 form-wizard shell with the approved professional shop-software chassis.
objectives: Implement the dark charcoal/black application shell, dark left job navigation, warm white/light-gray central working sheet, restrained semantic colors, strong typography hierarchy, generous spacing, and subtle stacked-sheet depth from the approved design direction.

Implement a persistent vehicle/RO strip that can display vehicle, installed engine, carburetor, transmission, RO number, and current technician from real available job state; never fabricate missing values.
Create the reviewable workflow chassis for Static Pages 1-5, Dynamic Tuning Stack, Job Overview, and Customer Report/Finalize.

Build Pages 1-5 with the correct information architecture and progressive-disclosure homes defined by the blueprint. Reuse existing validated vehicle/job/history/configuration services wherever possible rather than duplicating them.

Create one representative Dynamic Stack sheet using OBJECTIVE -> EVIDENCE -> ACTION -> VERIFICATION -> OUTCOME, with data/state boundaries suitable for later knowledge-graph reasoning. Do not fake diagnostic conclusions.
Keep workflow progression state-ready: technician inputs facts; system owns status/progression. Do not implement click-through overrides as a shortcut.

Preserve saved-job compatibility, vehicle/chassis versus installed-engine independence, duplicate/delete safeguards, immutable historical job/configuration behavior, and CT-0059 validation-currentness semantics.
Make the milestone responsive and practical on desktop and iPhone-sized layouts.

visualContract.navigation: dark persistent left job index on desktop; responsive equivalent on narrow screens
visualContract.workSurface: warm white/light gray central technician sheet
visualContract.red: actual fault or hard stop only

acceptanceCriteria: A technician can click through the complete redesigned shell from Page 1 through Page 5, see the Dynamic Stack workspace, then Overview and Report without encountering the old Build 51 visual structure as the primary workflow.
Pages 1-5 have distinct purposes matching CARBTUNE_BLUEPRINT.md rather than generic repeated forms.
The persistent job context and navigation remain understandable at desktop and iPhone widths.
The representative Stack sheet clearly expresses Objective, Evidence, Action, Verification, and Outcome and does not invent vehicle facts or diagnostic results.
Existing persisted vehicle/job/history data remains readable and core CT-0059/CT-0060 safeguards remain intact.
Canonical validation passes, JavaScript syntax passes, diff check passes, and responsive/browser assertions are updated or added for the new shell.
No production merge to main occurs as part of this task. The deliverable is a reviewable design-branch implementation plus a complete handoff report.
implementationNotes: This is intentionally a UI/workflow-chassis milestone, not the full automotive knowledge graph or final reasoning engine.
Do not solve the task by merely reskinning old page names. The new information architecture must be visible in the implementation.
Where deeper reasoning is not implemented yet, expose honest neutral states such as awaiting verification rather than fabricated recommendations.

Prefer extracting reusable design tokens/components/state boundaries over piling more ad hoc CSS onto the existing monolithic page, but do not destabilize validated infrastructure with an unnecessary framework rewrite.
